title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・君臨する悪役

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Amazing! The only Umamusume to stand in the way of Oguri Cap the Hero!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's Super Creek! The winner of the autumn Tenno Sho is Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Heheheh, this is what happens when my trainer and I get serious!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You ran well, Oguri! I may have even been a teensy bit nervous. ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Urgh, you're a tough opponent… I didn't think you'd stick it out on the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But this still isn't stettled. I want both you and Tamtam to take me on next time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Our final battle will be the Arima Kinen. To all our fans out there, please come and watch the climax, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we did it! Did I pull off the villain act?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, then how about I praise you in a villainous way as your reward?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Come, bow your head in submission.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Heheh! Such a fine subordinate. Yes you are!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her villainous act, Super Creek's touch is as gentle as always.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Only the senior Arima Kinen remains. Winning that will make me the queen…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And you, the queen's prized trainer, will be the best in the world! ♪ Let's make our dream come true—together.
